title: SeverActions
tagline: An action, prompt, and behavior pack for SkyrimNet
description:
SeverActions extends SkyrimNet with actions, prompts, and a native SKSE plugin that together let NPCs act on what they say. They follow you and travel across Skyrim, craft and cook and brew, manage their outfits, handle gold and debt, sit down, fight, get arrested and escorted to jail, settle disputes with fists, run businesses for you, and remember what happened.

One principle runs through all of it: the AI decides what to do, and the mod makes it happen in-game — with the engine's own systems, not around them.
author: severause
changelog:
## **SeverActions v4.9.2 - Arms and Oaths**

Outfits that carry weapons, NPCs who attend each other around the clock, outlaw camps with a temper, a say in who tags along, and food your followers leave alone.

:busts_in_silhouette: **The people around you**
- **Anyone can attend someone:** Attend on the Companions page's Work row, Attend Someone on the Actions page, or ask in conversation. Give the role in your own words (bodyguard, squire, lady's maid), change it any time, and both NPCs are told.
- **Work hours for anyone:** a new Work hours row under Work sets an NPC's own hours. **24 h** keeps them at their post, or at someone's side, around the clock.
- **NPCs you only gave work have a card** in the Companions page's Assigned NPCs, so you can change their role or hours there.
- **Choose who tags along:** Settings > Followers > Ask Before NPCs Tag Along (on by default) shows a card when an NPC agrees to walk with you. Those who come know they still are.
- **SkyrimNet's Accompany** now follows you through doors, and asks first when the card is on.
- **Companions cast the spells you ask for,** even while following or waiting.
- **NPCs teach each other spells:** in conversation, or pick a Student for Teach Spell on the Actions page.
- **Followers remember thane quests and the jarls' tasks,** which quest awareness used to skip. **Remember Minor Quests** (Settings > Background AI, off by default) adds favors, odd jobs, bounties and city tasks.

- See announcement page for more
